quarterly_data.signal: First half of the fiscal year ending March 2026 (April-September 2025; semi-annual report): net sales JPY 559.0 billion (+24.9% year on year), operating income JPY 90.2 billion (+63.5%), ordinary income JPY 91.7 billion (+75.7%), net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 67.1 billion (+133.7%). By segment: Information & Communications net sales JPY 303.5 billion (+63.4%) and operating income JPY 73.8 billion (+117.5%), as data-center demand driven by the spread and expansion of generative AI kept growing; Electronics net sales JPY 86.2 billion (-2.4%) and operating income down 55.5%, as the downstream supply-chain problem feared since the start of the year materialised, plus higher costs from the strong baht, delayed productivity improvement on new-model products and intensifying competition; Automotive net sales JPY 86.2 billion (-6.2%) and operating income down 38.0%, still profitable but with lower delivery volumes as order programs reached a changeover period, and soaring material costs; Energy net sales JPY 73.2 billion (+2.2%) and operating income up 52.0% on more shipments of high-margin products and better selling prices; Real Estate (Fukagawa Gatharia rental income) net sales up 2.8%. Group R&D spending in the half was JPY 9.2 billion, with no material change in R&D activities; no material contracts.
